title: Private prompt execution test
boundary: This is a separate execution that sends data to an external model and may incur charges. It does not select, promote or publish a revision. Private access controls are not an Agent, CLI or filesystem sandbox.
profile: Supported profile only: built-in Claude CLI bare mode with an explicitly configured API key, legacy/local/fresh execution; no Paperclip token, runtime tools, MCP or bridge. Subscription login, overrides, ACP/native, remote and resumed sessions are unsupported; there is no fallback.
contextBoundary: Approval binds the fixed Agent configuration, revision and dataset case. Derived execution configuration has a hash witness only; this is not a complete capture or prior approval of all hidden model context.
confirmProfile: I approve the restricted API-key profile without Paperclip tools. This does not authorize switching a subscription account to API billing.
confirmExecution: I authorize one real execution using these fixed references and the Agent configuration.
confirmCharges: I understand that this sends data to an external model and may incur charges.
order: Pages use UUID order, not chronology. Refresh to read the latest recorded state.
disabled: Execution is disabled or this profile is unavailable. An operator must enable the server execution gate and configure a supported Agent profile; this page never enables it automatically.
readFailed: Private data is hidden because this read failed or administrator access expired. Refresh after restoring access.
saved: Execution intent saved. Inspect its recorded state; queued or prepared does not mean completed.
unknown: The response is uncertain. Inputs are frozen. Recover this exact request ID; do not start another test. Leaving this page loses in-memory recovery state, so inspect server history before authorizing anything new.
conflict: The head or request binding changed. Review current registry state and all references before confirming again.
rejected: The server rejected this request. Verify the enabled profile, permissions and fixed references before confirming again.
preparedBoundary: Prepared records a hash of the final prompt. It does not prove process spawn, stdin delivery or provider consumption.
spawnedBoundary: A process spawn was recorded. This is not proof that the provider consumed the prompt.
completedBoundary: Completed means this adapter execution ended with a usable result. It does not prove correctness, provider consumption or publication approval.
resultBoundary: Private, bounded adapter result only. Full stdout/stderr and complete model context are not available. Text is displayed inertly.
resultUnavailable: No complete private result is available for this state. Unknown or failed execution must not be retried automatically.
